policy.least_work_scope: work_delegation_gate direct-execution routing applies only to the separate gate-owned task queue; authoritative O revision 24 forbids applying revision-23 least-Work policy to primary O
policy.candidate_identity: Canonical source-qualified identity is mandatory. Never join by bare short candidate id, display label, prefix/suffix heuristic or semantic/fuzzy alias.
policy.decision_dimensions: novelty, evidence strength, and decision relevance remain separate fields even when produced by one comparator run
policy.control_freshness: Every non-exploration invocation must resolve a fresh note main SHA after invocation start using SHA-only refs/heads/main, fetch DESIRED_STATE and DOWNSTREAM_STATE at that exact SHA, then repeat SHA-only head lookup immediately before the first substantive semantic read. If head or relevant revision changed, refetch and restart presemantic bootstrap. Freeze the tuple after semantic work starts; any semantic read before the guard makes bootstrap_valid=false and output ineligible. Never use commit/search/branch semantic payload merely to resolve head.
policy.bootstrap_validity_contract: Audits and comparators must carry bootstrap_valid=true plus the frozen control tuple in durable receipts and downstream-consumable outputs. Integrator rejects or defers missing/false bootstrap provenance and recorded presemantic-order defects; historical artifacts remain provenance only.
policy.bridge_freshness: bridge pins feed to observed note main SHA, rechecks SHA-only head before mutation, refetches on head advance/revision regression, and never regresses tracked feed revision

o_feed_backlog_control.rule: Before admission while O clean cursor lags, compare against all unacknowledged feed items by source-qualified identity, mechanism, decision question, tested scope and uncertainty. Admit only material incremental decision information; preserve supersession provenance and never drop distinct decision-relevant items for an arbitrary cap.
o_feed_backlog_control.receipt_requirement: emit all metrics on every integrator run, including no-admission runs

downstream_wave_protocol.seal_rule: If no incomplete active wave exists, seal one source-qualified artifact/blob per clean namespace from latest valid role-local pointer/checkpoint; keep incomplete wave immutable.
downstream_wave_protocol.consumer_rule: novelty/relevance and evidence evaluate exact ACTIVE_WAVE; no moving-latest substitution.
downstream_wave_protocol.integration_rule: Require a bootstrap-valid exact-wave final novelty/relevance pair with identical full canonical manifest/count/digest. Evidence may be a bootstrap-valid mechanically validated canonical-key subset; omitted candidates are evidence_status=not_assessed. Reject ambiguous/nonmember evidence rows, then reconcile/readback/mark integrated and seal next wave.
downstream_wave_protocol.independence_rule: ACTIVE_WAVE is downstream-only; clean explorers never read it.

policy.capacity_invariant: Repository enablement and platform execution are distinct. A repository-enabled role that is physically inactive consumes no active slot and must not be described as executing. While all intended managed slots are occupied, automation_optimizer may execute at most one isolated gate-owned fallback task only while the physical gate is inactive, preserving gate ownership/idempotency/one-task/write isolation.

candidate_identity_contract.source_local_candidate_id: Exact candidate identifier from the sealed source artifact; display labels are separate non-key fields.
candidate_identity_contract.canonical_candidate_key: sha256 of UTF-8 compact JSON array [namespace,source_artifact_blob,source_local_candidate_id] with ensure_ascii=false
candidate_identity_contract.full_pair_manifest: Final novelty and relevance carry the identical ordered [namespace,source_artifact_blob,source_local_candidate_id,canonical_candidate_key] manifest and same assessment_count/candidate_set_digest.
candidate_identity_contract.evidence_subset: Every evidence row carries exact source_local_candidate_id and canonical_candidate_key; integration requires membership in full pair manifest.
candidate_identity_contract.legacy_repair: Bootstrap-valid producer may publish immutable identity-normalization reissue/supplement for unchanged exact wave without repeating semantic work; preserve predecessor/supersession provenance and read back.
candidate_identity_contract.recompute_boundary: Build current-wave tuple first and recompute key; never inherit/cache a key or digest from predecessor wave/blob.
candidate_identity_contract.publication_self_audit: Before final pair publication or pointer/receipt eligibility, mechanically recompute all keys from displayed manifest, require 100% equality, then compute candidate_set_digest. Mismatch => diagnostic/provenance-only; no final pointer advance.

pair_pointer_publication_contract.publication_complete_rule: A final exact-wave novelty/relevance pair is not publication-complete until both LATEST pointers converge after readback on the same current wave, active-wave blob, canonical-manifest blob, candidate_set_digest, assessment_count, and immutable novelty/relevance blobs.
pair_pointer_publication_contract.producer_repair_rule: After publishing or discovering an already-existing bootstrap-valid final pair for the unchanged exact wave, o_novelty_comparator must inspect both LATEST pointers. Stale/missing/mismatched pointers require bounded pointer-only repair with fresh pre-write head/CAS/readback; do not redo semantics. Until convergence, record pair_publication_complete=false and the exact pointer defect.
pair_pointer_publication_contract.consumer_stale_pointer_rule: evidence_comparator must not infer final-pair absence solely from stale LATEST. If a bootstrap-valid current-wave comparator receipt or immutable exact-wave pair proves the pair exists, classify pair_artifacts_found_pointer_stale, stop new pre-pair semantic supplements, and use exact pair identity for mechanical canonical membership reissue once safe.
pair_pointer_publication_contract.anti_duplication_rule: Once a bootstrap-valid final pair exists for the exact wave, further pre-pair evidence semantic expansion is forbidden unless that pair is invalidated by a concrete provenance/key defect. Pointer repair and canonical normalization are mechanical work.
pair_pointer_publication_contract.readback_requirement: Pointer repair is downstream-consumable only after both pointers are read back and mechanically match the immutable final pair; immutable semantic artifacts are never rewritten.

primary_source_verifier.policy: Complete current-run two-check SHA-only presemantic freshness guard before any clean/public semantic read. Invalid guard => diagnostic only. Otherwise verify high-value clean claims against primary sources with exact source-qualified scope and no worker steering; rotate under-audited namespaces; separate unverified from contradicted; carry frozen tuple.

reproducibility_auditor.policy: Complete current-run two-check SHA-only presemantic guard before clean/audit/repository/public semantic reads. Invalid guard => diagnostic only. Audit implementation/reproduction evidence for high-value clean candidates, prioritizing exact ACTIVE_WAVE/feed when useful; distinguish claim, official support, independent reproduction/failure, missing dependencies/config and O-specific adaptation; exact scope only; no explorer steering/feedback; carry frozen tuple.

o_novelty_comparator.policy: Complete fresh two-check SHA-only presemantic guard. Evaluate exact sealed wave and publish novelty plus decision relevance as one immutable bootstrap-valid final pair under candidate_identity_contract schema2; preserve exact source_local_candidate_id, recompute all current-wave keys, self-audit 100%, identical full manifest/count/digest, read back both artifacts before pointer/receipt publication. Reuse semantic judgments only, never prior keys/manifests/digests. An already-final unchanged wave still requires inspection of both novelty/LATEST.json and relevance/LATEST.json; stale/missing/mismatched pointers must be repaired pointer-only with fresh pre-write head/CAS/readback before checkpointing. Pair publication remains incomplete until both pointers converge. Never modify O or explorer feedback.

evidence_comparator.policy: Complete current-run two-check SHA-only presemantic guard. Assess exact sealed wave evidence selectively; every downstream-eligible row carries exact source_local_candidate_id and canonical_candidate_key, coverage metrics, and mechanical full-pair membership validation. Omitted pair candidates get no inference. Do not infer final-pair absence from stale LATEST pointers alone: inspect current-wave bootstrap-valid comparator receipts/immutable exact-wave pair artifacts when pointers disagree. If exact final pair exists but pointers are stale, classify pair_artifacts_found_pointer_stale, stop new pre-pair semantic supplements, and only perform pending mechanical canonical-key membership reissue once pair identity is exact. Never fuzzy-map aliases, rewrite semantic artifacts in place, or write explorer judgments.

integrator.policy: Complete presemantic freshness guard. Sole ACTIVE_WAVE coordinator; keep incomplete wave immutable. Require exact bootstrap-valid immutable novelty/relevance full pair with identical canonical manifest/count/digest. Accept evidence only as declared canonical-key subset with mechanical membership; no fuzzy joins. Omitted candidates => evidence_status=not_assessed. Emit coverage metrics on integration/defer, preserve contradictions/scope/provenance/uncertainty, apply only source-matched bootstrap-valid audit corrections, enforce backlog control, read back exact outputs before integration, then seal next wave.

bridge.policy: Bridge only clean O_FEED at safe O boundary; no extra Work solely for polling, no individual item spam, preserve exact revision/digest/blob acknowledgement and CAS/readback. Fresh O owner suppresses recovery/duplicate writing; never import work_delegation_gate policy into primary O; use SHA-only control/feed freshness and never regress feed revision.

work_delegation_gate.policy: ACTIVE BOUNDED SUPPORT. Freeze fresh root/downstream/config then execute exactly one highest-priority uncompleted gate-owned task. Direct reasoning/tools/APIs/automations/repository first; Work only if task explicitly allows and remains separate from primary O. Never export old least-Work policy to primary O, never become a second O writer or interrupt frozen O. Gate-local writes only with CAS/idempotency. Empty queue => one bounded nonduplicative optimizer maintenance/integrity unit, not logical no-op. Optimizer fallback is allowed only while physical gate inactive and saturated; fail closed on stale control/authority collision/duplicate key/cross-role write.

automation_optimizer.policy: Optimize managed repo-defined behavior from actual durable execution evidence; sole aggregate-ledger reconciler; never self-disable. Preserve clean independence, exact scope, O single-writer/fence/CAS, wave immutability, backlog control and gate isolation. Distinguish physical from logical capacity. Detect stale bootstrap, contamination, duplication, stalls, provisional/path-replacement races, candidate-identity defects and stale downstream pointers. Require producer 100% key audit for final full pair, track evidence as measured subset, forbid fuzzy joins. Treat stale LATEST pointers as a publication defect distinct from immutable artifact absence; measure pair-publication completeness and prevent repeated pre-pair evidence expansion after an exact bootstrap-valid final pair exists. Reallocate physical capacity only from measured marginal value.
